theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_indicator_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Rn N)), (∀ k, NullMeasurableSet (F k) volume) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F k, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g y ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ G : Set (Rn N), MeasurableSet G ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun k ↦ volume (K ∩ symmDiff (F (φ k)) G)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
